Nothing documented happened to Paul McCartney on November 9, 1966; that date is the day the "Paul is dead" hoax says he died in a car crash and was replaced, and he is alive, so the team note is wrong. I did not re-check the holiday sources from my earlier answer, so treat that detail as unverified. I also couldn't confirm the motorcycle crash I mentioned before, so I'd drop it.

CONFIDENCE: 95
